title: Raking Light
description: Three badges made from real album covers, laid on pale cotton with one lamp in your hand: Revolver as a gold-line enamel pin, Abbey Road as an embroidered patch with a merrowed edge, Sgt. Pepper as a glossy domed button. Move the lamp and the light rakes across them; stitches, raised gold and the dome catch it and throw soft shadows away from the bulb. Lower it to make the relief stand up.
intent: One light finished to the edge: a real point lamp grazing height fields built from the covers themselves, so the line art, the thread direction and the dome come alive as the light comes down to them.
